'''Bennbus Polag''' was an [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] entrepreneur and criminal. Starting off by picking pockets and scamming others off their wealth, Polag moved onto to running guns, [[Dealmaker|fencing]] items, and even operating a [[Salt/Legends|salt]] [[Mining/Legends|mine]]. Eventually, he settled into a respectable role in local government on a backwater [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Polag was responsible for the capture of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Nallok]] with the intent of handing her over to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ANM" />
